author: terencechain
content:
Hi <@592004585506340885> , found a gossip spec question in gloas while debugging devnet-8 today. the beacon_block rule:

```python
# [IGNORE] If the parent block is full, the parent payload is valid
if is_parent_node_full(store, block):
    if not is_payload_verified(store, block.parent_root):
        raise GossipIgnore("parent payload is not verified")
```

is_payload_verified is just `root in store.payloads`, and invalid payloads never enter store.payloads `(on_execution_payload_envelope asserts VALID)`. so "verified invalid" and "not yet verified" are the same state here, and a block that builds on a payload my EL already proved INVALID gets IGNORE forever instead of REJECT. This used to be REJECT
